dedupe_keys.name: dataset for short term integration costs of variable renewable energy

description: Joos, Michael and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The spreadsheet contains data used to generate figures in the study of short-term variable-renewable integration costs in Britain and Germany. Its documented subject is wind curtailment and balancing, giving a concrete electricity-operation and cost-analysis role. This record represents the published figure-support dataset, not a complete market simulator or all operator-level records underlying the research. The brief description does not specify the time range, every cost variable or temporal resolution. The paper remains supporting methodological evidence and is not treated as the identity of a separate unrestricted data source. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
